notes.title: New Hero: Discover Novmei's gameplay!
notes.content:
[h2]A new heroine is arriving![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/065cf6acf7eb3b38559d1b6cdb8e3c134e93ca19.png[/img]

Novmei is the ninth character in Heat and Run! [b]We have waited patiently before introducing this second tanky heroine![/b] The double-edged nature of Novmei's ability poses a significant strategic challenge for players, [b]as each use of the blocks must be carefully measured. [/b]And it's no exaggeration; if Novmei's mana drops to 0, she will be unable to build blocks for five seconds. A true ordeal in Heat and Run!

[list]
[*] Novmeí’s mana absorbs 90% of damage taken.
[*] When her mana drops to 0, Novmeí is Silenced for 5 seconds, and doesn’t regenerate mana until the effect ends.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/820a1570442882eae877e81bfee3712f482cc67c.jpg[/img]
[i]Novmeì is a live legend. The Thaumaturgist was born with rune-sculpted skin. It's only when the war broke that the island uncovers her power, hidden by her peers until then: Novmeì is immune to pain and leaves to fight for the Kingdom.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/d05e6db4f0b818b71c1a47dae2c3ef76a5753cc7.png[/img]

[h2]Other contents of the update:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Displaying certain voice commands on-screen for you and your allies.
[*] The competition organization site [url=https://toornament.com/]Toornament[/url] has listed Heat and Run, feel free to create your events!
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[/list]

Keep yourself informed and discuss with us our [url=https://discord.com/invite/HjMefbK]discord[/url].

[i]We hope you will have fun playing!
[b]Damnatio Games.[/b][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1225790/Heat_and_Run/

notes.title: Summer Update: You can now select an opponent's Hero!
notes.content:
Summer update is now available!

[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list][*] You can now select a Hero that is already on the opposing team.
[*] The spray of the glocktail has been softened to allow everyone a better aim without using many complex tricks.
[*] Bots now have the appearance and name of heroes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/3ac6e89c1fb38f698f5d69c84225c87002988863.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/e4865138d9d909b6ea75af05a7b08de2f1db1c95.png[/img]
[h2]Bug fixing:[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed a bug in Glocktail: several shots could be fired instead of one.
[*] Fixed bug in elimination history.
[*] Voice improvement based on distance.
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Upcoming update:[/h2]

The next update will contain at least one new hero to play! We will give you more information about his skills in the coming days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/335f4af4785ebd3e3b196ce2eb6bb17242b3c86e.png[/img]

Keep yourself informed and discuss with us our [url=https://discord.com/invite/HjMefbK]discord[/url].

[i]We hope you will have fun playing!
[b]Damnatio Games.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Spring Update: New features & significant bug fixing!
notes.content:
Spring update is now available. A bit late, so we’ve put a few extra efforts to make it as complete as possible!

[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list][*] Added damage to opponents in the TAB scoreboard.
[*] Added damage to the Opponent Flame in the TAB scoreboard.
[*] Added a ping location system to communicate with your allies (C key).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/457ce635b9b1536b80049c8583c4f002fa908e66.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/e18011235b17349607c59c5e3d896a4f6bbcafe1.png[/img]
[h2]Significant bug fixing:[/h2]

﻿As planned, we want to focus on technical issues at the initial stages of the Early Access. So this update was the perfect time to fix a lot of known bugs! But please feel free to join our community on discord right now to help us fixing some bugs and to make suggestions you might have that will help us achieve the best possible version of Heat and Run.

[list][*] Target’s visual has been improved.
[*] Added a visual on Arson’s arm when he activates his ability.
[*] The position of the Panic icon no longer shake without reason.
[*] Elden can no longer activate his skill on an already eliminated opponent.
[*] The circle around Solkan turns red if an opponent is there, and thus if activation of his ability is impossible.
[*] Paran’s Dash is now invisible in hideouts.
[*] Knocked display now actually lasts 5 seconds.
[*] The Crown Relic now blocks the damage of your own Dynameats.
[*] Visual correction of Dynameats trajectory particles.
[*] Corrected some score data displayed in TAB.
[*] Flames Health Points no longer reset to Win and Lose displays.
[*] Sound bugs solved, related to the music of the selection menu and the winning sound.
[*] Graphical correction of some texts in play.
[*] Moving the lobby with your mouse cursor should be easier.
[*] The animation for new message received should no longer appear on already opened chats.
[*] Corrected incorrect displays in the Teams menu.
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[/list]

Keep yourself informed and discuss with us our [url=https://discord.com/invite/HjMefbK]discord[/url].

[i]We hope you will have fun playing!
[b]Damnatio Games.[/b][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1225790/Heat_and_Run/

notes.title: Relics Update: 6 new relics to discover!
notes.content:
We are pleased to present you six new relics to select at the beginning of the game!

They are divided into defense, attack and utility categories, and some encourage team play more than others:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41226454/f9640741dff033ddc9854bccdbf6f701dbe5095a.png[/img]

If you do not know which relic to choose with this or that Hero, we have specified our tips in the selection menu, in the third tab represented by the hand:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41226454/8c3cba56bdf4981e008f01eb7085f8cfb1fb75c2.png[/img]

[u]We also took the opportunity to fix some bugs:[/u]

[list]
[*] Damage text was misplaced in tutorials.
[*] Damage dealt doubled for no reason.
[*] Respawning could give a kill to another player.
[/list]

Keep yourself informed and discuss with us our [url=https://discord.com/invite/HjMefbK]discord[/url].

[i]We hope you will have fun playing!
[b]Damnatio Games.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Tutorial Update: Out now!
notes.content:
The first Heat and Run content update is now available!

[h1]Tutorials:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/51def2ef90037f7505c7aff97d7ccacb4613fbbd.png[/img]

Perfect for beginners and anyone who would like to get extra tips, we have integrated three mini tutorials in the Welcome menu, to do as much as you want before you get into real games!

[list]
[*] Control your movements and create blocks.
[*] Learn how to use both weapons depending on situations and threats.
[*] Paran's ability is put into practice, a formidable dash at all levels
[*] Practice some essential tricks, especially to attack!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/9dc9c76b24df21211e371ab3385daa4425c84e59.png[/img]

[h1]Friends list:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/3cdd98cea0522f94d85b47449212e7ed819864b8.png[/img]

The friends list and the private chat system had been disabled at the launch of early access to avoid a critical bug, we had no choice. We have decided to reactivate these two essential features and we remain vigilant about the bugs they can cause!

[h2]Roadmap udpated:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/17d2c7fb4a4de8dfa6710281527a92a1562a0d32.png[/img]

[u]In case you missed our first patch in October published on our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/HjMefbK]discord[/url]: [/u]

[list][*] Crash when trying to build a block outside the map.
[*] Rare return to the selection menu when entering the game.
[*] Mavonomicon relic hits twice in a row for no reason.
[*] Bug display on Akona map when ending game twice in a row against bots.[/list]

Keep yourself informed and discuss with us our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/HjMefbK]discord[/url].

[i]We hope you will have fun playing!
[b]Damnatio Games.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Heat and Run is available now in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/53b818340f2f82b648bf274a80507388a1a57b99.png[/img]

We are proud to announce that [b]Heat and Run has entered into Early Access[/b] on Steam!

It is our first game and the support of our community has been crucial for its development, it's been a long journey! We would like to start this announcement with a [b]big thank you to all the playtesters[/b] from the prototype in 2018 to the demo in 2021! [i]Without you, nothing would have been possible! ♥[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/c995be31fe7c00f27a298944be5daf810d2a9ca1.png[/img]
A lot of improvements and features have been added since the demo and we will continue to develop this unique online experience. [b]New heroes, maps, relics and functions[/b] are well underway internally, and will be making their way to the game over time. We can't wait to hear what all of you think!

Because we are a small team, we need to [b]focus on technical issues at the initial stages[/b] of the Early Access. But please feel free to [b][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/HjMefbK]join our community on discord[/url][/b] right now to make suggestions you might have that will help us realize the best possible version of Heat and Run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/84575ff5aedde1d9e95c70d523096f62fca099f6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/65063b661cfc018947a6d4d1de122b2af7f175fa.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=8Y5eKBl4UNw;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/a4fc55366747a8f48a3346982bf01ce39f6adb29.png[/img]
It is likely that several crashes occur during the first days of early access, our main mission is to solve them as soon as possible! [b][url=https://discordapp.com/invite/HjMefbK]Join our discord now[/url][/b] to help us develop Heat and Run: share your opinions, your ideas and the bugs you will encounter!

[b][u]Known critical bugs:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Servers are strong but unknown individual actions could make them crash, we stand ready to solve it!
[*]Changing map in a custom game can cause a crash.
[*]Try to avoid alt tab during loading screens.
[*]If your game crashes regularly in the lobby, try to troubleshoot from the servers menu, please read the informative text carefully.
[*]If you have freezes, disable "HIGH QUALITY ANIMATIONS" in audio video options (press esc while you are  in-game).
[*]Resolutions not 16:9 can cause problems.
[*]Resolutions above 4K are not supported.
[*]Sometimes, Steam avatar and nickname is not displayed.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/ae97fa70ea1270ed35f37b81d72ab61e0a2325cf.png[/img] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1225790/Heat_and_Run/
[i]We hope you will have fun playing!
[b]Damnatio Games.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Demo updates + Our participation in Steam #NextFest
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

The team worked hard to update the demo while working on the contents of the final version. For those who have missed the recent evolutions of the demo and the project, here is a complete summary:

[h3][u][b]📋 PATCH 0.40 to 0.45:[/b][/u][/h3]

GAMEPLAY:
[list][*] Solkan has been reworked.
[*] Elden now has an active ability.
[*] Glocktail now has 20 ammos.
[*] The Flame gains a runic shield when it suffers too much damage!
[*] You now select your team first then your hero/heroine.
[*] Warmup ends with 2 players connected.
[*] 4 seconds to respawn + 1 second every 2 minutes.[/list]
NEW CONTENT:
[list][*] Musics and sounds have been added.
[*] Some visuals & HUD have been added.
[*] Collisions has been reworked to limit blocking situations between map platforms and Blocks
[*] American servers are available.[/list]
DEV:
[list][*] A LOT of minor bugs fixed.
[*] Fixed several crashes and major bugs encountered during recent playtests, [i]thanks again to all participants. 💙[/i][/list]
[h2][u][b]Participation in #NextFest:[/b][/u][/h2]

[b]We are also happy to announce that we'll be participating in the Steam #NextFest starting on Monday (June 13-20)![/b]

[list][*] A steam showcase of many independent games in development
[*] We are working on the 0.46 patch.
[*] Support Heat and Run by adding the game to your wishlist! 💙[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36855744/2b3c23d0e59d843f0bfd50ae75ff8f539d92ee2a.png[/img]

[i]Remember that the game is still in development. Thanks to your feedback and testing, Heat and Run will improve, and we look forward to that.[/i]
